sources.title: Franka Panda — Pick & Place with AI Models - GitHub
sources.snippet: A browser-based embodied-reasoning demo. A model (Gemini, Claude, or GPT) looks at a simulated 3D scene, returns 2D detections for the objects you asked about, and the Franka Emika Panda arm picks them up and drops them in a tray.
